title: Argument markers: summing up a balance

sections.content: You know *en resumen*, *lo más importante es que* and *destaca que* from B1 Unit 13, and you have seen *por un lado … por otro lado* in ordering ideas. They help to give a balance of a period: what the main challenges were, and what matters most.

items.spanish: En resumen, los nuevos países tenían tres grandes desafíos.
items.english: In summary, the new countries had three big challenges.

items.spanish: Por un lado, el comercio daba ingresos; por otro lado, hacía a los países dependientes.
items.english: On the one hand, trade gave income; on the other, it made countries dependent.

items.spanish: Lo más importante es que los Estados eran todavía débiles.
items.english: The most important thing is that the states were still weak.

items.spanish: Muchos historiadores destacan que la economía dependía de pocos productos.
items.english: Many historians point out that the economy depended on few products.

sections.content: Use *por un lado* and *por otro lado* for two sides of one point, *lo más importante es que* for your main point, and *en resumen* to close. A good summary lists the main ideas without adding new ones.
